query: What is the capital of France and roughly its population?
summary:
**Paris is the capital of France, and its city-proper population is roughly 2.0–2.1 million people.** The capital status is confirmed independently by Wikipedia, the UNECE statistical database, and the France Wikipedia entry [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]] [[web_355839e59ca1c6c3253834e1]] [[web_33ecd7817998866131cc914d]].

For population, the authoritative INSEE 2023 census puts the Paris commune at 2,103,778 [[web_7a785252b8bcd3717872395e]] [[web_942c04b6ae83e6189f32b13d]], while INSEE's provisional estimate for 1 January 2026 is 2,047,600 [[web_ac6cd7e5b4471e5c7eda3040]] — the difference reflects a documented ongoing decline of about 0.6–0.9% per year, not a contradiction.

At wider scales, the Île-de-France region holds about 12.6 million people as of 1 January 2026 [[web_ac6cd7e5b4471e5c7eda3040]], and the Paris metropolitan area about 13.3 million (2023) [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]].

sections.title: Capital status
sections.markdown: Multiple independent sources agree that Paris is France's capital. The Wikipedia article on Paris is framed explicitly as being about the "Capital of France," and its administration section states that as the capital, Paris hosts the seat of national government: the President at the Élysée Palace, the Prime Minister at Hôtel Matignon, and both houses of Parliament (the Senate in the Palais du Luxembourg and the National Assembly in the Palais Bourbon) [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]]. The UNECE statistical database lists France's capital as "Paris" in its country profile [[web_355839e59ca1c6c3253834e1]], and the France Wikipedia entry identifies Paris as the country's "capital and largest city" [[web_33ecd7817998866131cc914d]]. The Île-de-France Wikipedia article likewise describes the region as "containing the capital city of France, Paris" [[web_a24a5ce4ace54683d22d207e]]. There is no disagreement among sources on this point.

sections.title: Population of Paris city proper
sections.markdown:
The best-anchored figure for the city itself comes from INSEE, France's national statistics office. The 2023 census gives the Paris commune a municipal population of 2,103,778, with a density of about 19,960 inhabitants per km² [[web_7a785252b8bcd3717872395e]]. These figures are the official "populations de référence" for 2023, authenticated by decree and in force from 1 January 2026 [[web_942c04b6ae83e6189f32b13d]]. INSEE's provisional estimate for 1 January 2026 is lower, at 2,047,600, with the Paris department losing roughly 18,000 residents during 2025 [[web_ac6cd7e5b4471e5c7eda3040]]. Wikipedia's infobox carries the same January 2026 estimate of 2,047,602 [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]].

The gap between the 2023 census figure and the 2026 estimate is consistent with a long-running decline rather than a data conflict: INSEE records an average annual population change of −0.6% between 2017 and 2023, driven by a negative migration balance (−1.2%/yr) that outweighs a positive natural balance (+0.5%/yr) [[web_7a785252b8bcd3717872395e]]. Wikipedia reports the city lost 122,919 residents (about 5%) between 2013 and 2023 [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]]. The historical series shows this is a long-term pattern: the commune peaked at 2,590,771 in 1968 and has fallen to 2,103,778 in 2023 [[web_942c04b6ae83e6189f32b13d]] [[web_b88b792206e59adc55fa8067]], and is well below the historical peak of about 2.9 million in 1921 [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]].

sections.title: Wider scales: region and metro area
sections.markdown:
Which population is "the population of Paris" depends on the geographic scope, and the evidence supports a clear ordering. The Île-de-France region — often called the Paris Region — was estimated at 12,594,500 inhabitants on 1 January 2026, growing 0.36% in 2025, though Paris itself was the only department losing population [[web_ac6cd7e5b4471e5c7eda3040]]. An earlier official estimate put the region at 12,271,794 on 1 January 2023 [[web_a24a5ce4ace54683d22d207e]]. The Paris metropolitan area (aire d'attraction) was 13,320,752 in 2023 per INSEE data cited by Wikipedia [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]], and the France Wikipedia article describes a metropolitan population of over 13 million [[web_33ecd7817998866131cc914d]]. An intermediate scope, the Métropole du Grand Paris (Paris plus inner-suburb departments and airport communes, 814 km²), had 6.945 million residents in 2015 — a useful benchmark, though the figure is dated [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]].

For national context, France's total population was 68,776,000 in 2024 per UNECE [[web_355839e59ca1c6c3253834e1]], with a January 2026 estimate of about 69.08 million including overseas France [[web_33ecd7817998866131cc914d]]. On these figures, the city of Paris holds roughly 3% of the national population and the Île-de-France region roughly 18–19%.

sections.title: Limits of the evidence
sections.markdown: The figures above are well-sourced but carry conditions worth stating plainly. The 2023 census figure (2,103,778) is the official authenticated number, while the 1 January 2026 figures are provisional estimates that INSEE revises — the Île-de-France population for 1 January 2025 was itself revised upward from 12,450,900 to 12,549,300 between publications [[web_ac6cd7e5b4471e5c7eda3040]]. One attempted cross-check (citypopulation.de) returned only a bot-check page and contributed no data [[web_38bd1659b47e0435ccd12ed1]]. A Wikipedia list of French departments carries an explicit out-of-date-information notice and reports an older 2019 legal population for the Paris department (2,165,423) [[web_b89c42c5dc5be26b495c8aea]]; it is consistent with the decline trend but superseded by the INSEE census figures. No source in the evidence pool provides a more recent official figure than the provisional 2026 estimates, so the "current" population is best stated as approximately 2.0–2.1 million for the city proper, with the exact value depending on the reference date.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.markdown: The answer is settled on both parts. Paris is the capital of France, where the President, Prime Minister, and both parliamentary houses sit [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]] [[web_355839e59ca1c6c3253834e1]] [[web_33ecd7817998866131cc914d]]. Its population is roughly 2.0–2.1 million within the city limits: 2,103,778 per the official 2023 census [[web_7a785252b8bcd3717872395e]] [[web_942c04b6ae83e6189f32b13d]], trending down to a provisional 2,047,600 at the start of 2026 [[web_ac6cd7e5b4471e5c7eda3040]]. Readers should match the scope to their purpose — about 2 million for the city, about 7 million for the Greater Paris metropolis (2015 figure) [[web_d78712e345451b942555c838]], and about 12.6 million for the Île-de-France region [[web_ac6cd7e5b4471e5c7eda3040]] — and note that the city's population has been declining for decades while the wider region continues to grow [[web_7a785252b8bcd3717872395e]] [[web_ac6cd7e5b4471e5c7eda3040]].

claim.text: **Paris is the capital of France, and its city-proper population is roughly 2.0–2.1 million people.** The capital status is confirmed independently by Wikipedia, the UNECE statistical database, and the France Wikipedia entry

For population, the authoritative INSEE 2023 census puts the Paris commune at 2,103,778, while INSEE's provisional estimate for 1 January 2026 is 2,047,600 — the difference reflects a documented ongoing decline of about 0.6–0.9% per year, not a contradiction
At wider scales, the Île-de-France region holds about 12.6 million people as of 1 January 2026, and the Paris metropolitan area about 13.3 million (2023)
Multiple independent sources agree that Paris is France's capital

The Wikipedia article on Paris is framed explicitly as being about the "Capital of France," and its administration section states that as the capital, Paris hosts the seat of national government: the President at the Élysée Palace, the Prime Minister at Hôtel Matignon, and both houses of Parliament (the Senate in the Palais du Luxembourg and the National Assembly in the Palais Bourbon)
The UNECE statistical database lists France's capital as "Paris" in its country profile, and the France Wikipedia entry identifies Paris as the country's "capital and largest city"
The Île-de-France Wikipedia article likewise describes the region as "containing the capital city of France, Paris"
There is no disagreement among sources on this point
The best-anchored figure for the city itself comes from INSEE, France's national statistics office
The 2023 census gives the Paris commune a municipal population of 2,103,778, with a density of about 19,960 inhabitants per km²
These figures are the official "populations de référence" for 2023, authenticated by decree and in force from 1 January 2026
INSEE's provisional estimate for 1 January 2026 is lower, at 2,047,600, with the Paris department losing roughly 18,000 residents during 2025
Wikipedia's infobox carries the same January 2026 estimate of 2,047,602

The gap between the 2023 census figure and the 2026 estimate is consistent with a long-running decline rather than a data conflict: INSEE records an average annual population change of −0.6% between 2017 and 2023, driven by a negative migration balance (−1.2%/yr) that outweighs a positive natural balance (+0.5%/yr)
Wikipedia reports the city lost 122,919 residents (about 5%) between 2013 and 2023

The historical series shows this is a long-term pattern: the commune peaked at 2,590,771 in 1968 and has fallen to 2,103,778 in 2023, and is well below the historical peak of about 2.9 million in 1921

Which population is "the population of Paris" depends on the geographic scope, and the evidence supports a clear ordering

The Île-de-France region — often called the Paris Region — was estimated at 12,594,500 inhabitants on 1 January 2026, growing 0.36% in 2025, though Paris itself was the only department losing population
An earlier official estimate put the region at 12,271,794 on 1 January 2023
The Paris metropolitan area (aire d'attraction) was 13,320,752 in 2023 per INSEE data cited by Wikipedia, and the France Wikipedia article describes a metropolitan population of over 13 million

An intermediate scope, the Métropole du Grand Paris (Paris plus inner-suburb departments and airport communes, 814 km²), had 6.945 million residents in 2015 — a useful benchmark, though the figure is dated
For national context, France's total population was 68,776,000 in 2024 per UNECE, with a January 2026 estimate of about 69.08 million including overseas France
On these figures, the city of Paris holds roughly 3% of the national population and the Île-de-France region roughly 18–19%
The figures above are well-sourced but carry conditions worth stating plainly

The 2023 census figure (2,103,778) is the official authenticated number, while the 1 January 2026 figures are provisional estimates that INSEE revises — the Île-de-France population for 1 January 2025 was itself revised upward from 12,450,900 to 12,549,300 between publications
One attempted cross-check (citypopulation.de) returned only a bot-check page and contributed no data

A Wikipedia list of French departments carries an explicit out-of-date-information notice and reports an older 2019 legal population for the Paris department (2,165,423); it is consistent with the decline trend but superseded by the INSEE census figures

No source in the evidence pool provides a more recent official figure than the provisional 2026 estimates, so the "current" population is best stated as approximately 2.0–2.1 million for the city proper, with the exact value depending on the reference date
The answer is settled on both parts
Paris is the capital of France, where the President, Prime Minister, and both parliamentary houses sit
Its population is roughly 2.0–2.1 million within the city limits: 2,103,778 per the official 2023 census, trending down to a provisional 2,047,600 at the start of 2026

Readers should match the scope to their purpose — about 2 million for the city, about 7 million for the Greater Paris metropolis (2015 figure), and about 12.6 million for the Île-de-France region — and note that the city's population has been declining for decades while the wider region continues to grow
